$comment: Current values are identical to stage.json. Environment values represent runtime deployment targets and are expected to diverge as environment-specific targets (e.g., sandbox, canary) are added.
description: Authoritative registry of runtime environment names. An environment represents WHERE the system runs (a target deployment environment). Schema field environmentName in schema/core/collections.schema.json references this file as its canonical source.
